question: The value axis of a Chart: where it starts and ends, and its step. Predicted before the read. The four charts in CAP-T12LINECHART.json (line1) and CAP-T12CHARTSERIES.json (line3, bar3, flip3) were used to make the rule, so they are seen, not scored.
how: A new Chart on Blocks Probe, the default three rows (New York, Las Vegas, San Francisco) with one series, Population, typed as each set. Read as a Line Chart, a Bar Chart, and a Bar Chart with Flip X And Y Axes, twice each. Ticks read from the chart markup if it has any, else from the shot.

rule.name: snap then halve
steps: lo and hi are the lowest and highest value; a Bar Chart (flipped or not) takes lo = min(0, lo).
s = 10 to the power floor(log10(hi - lo)); lo goes down and hi goes up to a multiple of s.
Double s while one step is under 29px on the plot; then halve s while half a step is still at least 29px.
Ticks run from lo by s up to hi; the axis ends at hi even when hi is not a tick.
rule.plotHeights: Taken from the seen shots: Line 184, Bar 167 (its labels tilt), flipped Bar 183.
rule.threshold: 29, between the 27.8 that bar3 refused and the 30.5 that flip3 took.

scoring: Each of the 9 charts scores when its tick list matches the read exactly. One round, then up to 2 refits, then frozen.
